serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Annalie.face.normal
Lady Annalie: Hello there! What’s up?
You: Nothing much…
You: …
It became awkward right off the bat.
Lady Annalie: Are you here to buy something or…
You: Right. Uh. Not really.
You: I wanted to ask you about the news. You know, Melissa leaving.
Lady Annalie: I’m glad that she found herself a new job! Being a cashier for the rest of her life wasn’t really a good option.
You: That’s true, but how are you feeling about it? You two seemed to become really good friends in a short amount of time. 
#Annalie.Eyes.sad+Annalie.Mouth.normal
Lady Annalie: W-Well, I can’t say it wasn’t a big shock for me, but at the end of the day some things just take priority in life. 
Lady Annalie: I’m still kinda sad that she didn’t find any time to come and see me to say goodbye, but I guess that’s just how things are.
You: I hope that she…{{wi}} finds happiness there.
#Annalie.face.normal
Lady Annalie: You also seem shook about it. I guess that’s to be expected, you knew her longer, after all.
You: Yeah…
#Annalie.Eyes.pervy+Annalie.Mouth.surprised
Lady Annalie: It might sound weird, but…{{wi}} Doesn’t Melissa seem kinda weird to you? The way she replies to my messages…
Lady Annalie: Maybe I’m just looking too much into it, but it doesn’t seem like I’m talking with Melissa anymore…
#Annalie.Eyes.surprised+Annalie.Mouth.normal
Lady Annalie: Sorry! I’m sure that sounded weird! Just ignore me! 
Lady Annalie: I’m sure Melissa is also going through a lot right now, so for me to ask a question like that was just stupid.
#Annalie.face.normal
You: Don’t worry about it.
I can’t believe Annalie noticed that something was wrong even though {f_botName} didn’t…
You: Alright then, thank you for the talk. I will be going now.
Lady Annalie: Already? You didn’t even buy anything!
You: I’m not really in the mood today…
Lady Annalie: Sure thing.
Lady Annalie: Don’t worry about it too much. I’m sure we will see her again sometime.
You: Yeah…
